$description: Karl's button-pilot decisions (DEC-07, 2026-10-26; iOS rebuilt to the purchase button under DEC-22, 2026-11-19) and the provisional values the pilot uses where the source is silent. Read by scripts/build_button_tokens.py.

rules.colors: Keep the shipped colors (fill = action, white label). Markets where white fails 4.5:1 are a required change in IMPROVEMENTS CLR-04.
rules.radius: Keep each platform's shipped radius as a token: iOS 8 with a 0.7 pt border in the fill color (meter paywall purchase button, all 78 markets; DEC-22), Android 0.
rules.height: Keep each platform's shipped height as a token. Future change: one height for both (IMPROVEMENTS BTN-01).
rules.font: Core component; label font stays per platform (iOS Open Sans Bold 14 caps, Android system font caps). Future change: one label style (IMPROVEMENTS BTN-02).
rules.android_ui: Android code targets the View-based UI (XML styles and resources).

android_label_font.why: Material Components Button default (TextAppearance.MaterialComponents.Button). Confirmed by the Apps team (DREAMT-4719, 2026-11-19): Roboto Medium 14sp, all caps, letterSpacing 0.0893 on MaterialComponents screens and on the blocking paywall Subscribe. Screenshots (2026-11-19, MISSING-ASSETS 5.4 closed): the meter paywall purchase button is all caps; the subscription options are sentence case and bold.

disabled.why: Android ships these on Your News Continue; iOS has no disabled primary. Used for both apps (Core).

build: Primary: enabled, pressed (native platform feedback), disabled

ios_rebuild.what: iOS primary = the meter paywall purchase button (45 pt, radius 8, 0.7 pt border in the fill color, Open Sans Bold 14 uppercase, white label); text link = Open Sans Regular 14, whole sentence underlined. Replaces the provisional 44 pt height and the Log In / Register button values (radius 4; legacy 5 + 1 pt border), which production never shows.
